model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 59 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

facts.label: Name
facts.value: 勺园 / 弘雅园 / 集贤院 Shao Yuan, Hongya Yuan, Jixian Yuan

facts.label: In English
facts.value: Ladle Garden (Ming), later the envoys' and officials' house

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: the officials' duty house 集贤院 (from 1801); on 18 Sept 1860 Parkes and some thirty other prisoners were held at its 提督公所 (S1215; S02 p.187: local tradition); after 1860 abandoned (S1215); 'burned with 圆明园' (S1201 lead)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: today's name 勺园 of PKU's south-west complex (osm node 13787235273): C; Malone's sketch puts 集贤院 east of 畅春园's east wall, south of the old 勺园 / Yenching; its extent, a circle of 90 m, is assumed

facts.label: Note
facts.value: 米万钟's 勺园 c.1612-14 (S1216); Macartney lodged there 2 Aug 1793 (S02 p.166; S1215), Amherst 1816. Its Taihu rock in the 赛克勒 museum court; 'Mo Er Ken Yuan' (S02 p.107). Wording on 1860 kept factual.
